integrity: The enumeration is a complete finite proof with two differently ordered state generators and different move constructors. The known coloring count is explicitly credited; no claim of independent external validation or literature exhaustiveness is made.
scientific_limitations: Only the degree-five Clebsch graph, four distinguished colors and legal single-vertex moves are classified. General graph families, larger palettes and stochastic mixing times are not addressed. An inaccessible closely related full paper leaves residual publication-priority risk.
title: The exact optimal recoloring components of the Clebsch graph
